name: agent-plugins

plugins.name: claude-code-for-codex
plugins.description: Use Claude Code from Codex to review code or delegate tasks. A port of OpenAI's codex-plugin-cc with the direction of delegation reversed.

plugins.name: agent-builder
plugins.description: Creates, evaluates, and packages confirmed capabilities as one-agent-with-licensed-skills plugins.

plugins.name: behavior-implementer
plugins.description: Implements features scenario-first: Given/When/Then scenarios seen failing, the three laws of TDD, and a measured quality gate before every commit.

plugins.name: eval-writer
plugins.description: Defines measurable success criteria and designs evaluations for any LLM-based task, product, feature, or piece of logic.

plugins.name: unknown-remover
plugins.description: Classifies the unknown, picks the artifact form, and writes one planning document at a time from the five-document chain.

plugins.name: ui-verifier
plugins.description: Tests a macOS app's UI hands-free: off-screen launch, Accessibility-tree gates, screenshot capture with vision review, and golden AX-tree snapshot regression — every number measured, nothing advertised it cannot deliver.

description: Six agent plugins for Claude Code and Codex: unknown-remover (planning by unknown-removal), eval-writer (success criteria and evaluations), agent-builder (creates, evaluates, and packages capabilities), behavior-implementer (scenario-first BDD/TDD implementation), ui-verifier (hands-free macOS UI testing via Accessibility), and claude-code-for-codex (Claude Code delegation from Codex).
